name: Chris Christiansen
source:
Chris is the oldest son of [url=/c64151]Joseph[/url] and [url=/c75323]Mary[/url]. He doesn't speak very much to the player and often responds with sighs and shrugs. Since Chris is older than his siblings, he may be aware that his parents' marriage is strained.

[From the [url=https://dreamdaddy.fandom.com/wiki/Chris]Wiki[/url].]
